description: [STAGE 4: QUALITY AUDIT] Alias of basecoat_quality_inspector. Audit HTML/Astro markup and return a structured quality report.

code.description: HTML/component markup string to inspect for syntax violations, a11y omissions, and quality metrics.

componentId.description: Alternative component identifier alias to inspect.

densityProfile.description: Density profile context: "comfortable" (standard rhythm) or "compact" (dense micro-spacing allowed).

enforceFsm.description: Whether to strictly enforce FSM data-state bindings and field-group hierarchies on interactive controls.

environment.description: Target environment for inspection (defaults to html).

html.description: Alternative parameter alias for the code string to inspect.

id.description: Alternative component identifier alias to inspect.

markup.description: Alternative parameter alias for the markup snippet to inspect.

name.description: Alternative component identifier alias to inspect.

semanticProfile.description: Semantic token rhythm profile to validate against (defaults to "default").

name: inspect_quality
